channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Immanuel Quickley | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Immanuel Quickley from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Brandon Ingram on Darko Rajakovic, Immanuel Quickley, Scottie Barnes
item.description:
“And also, I just felt that I needed a fresh start. A fresh start somewhere where guys played hard and they listened. I heard good things about Scottie [Barnes], I heard good things about [Immanuel] Quickley and I thought it was a good fit offensively and defensively. And Darko [Rajakovic] had a part in that too.”

Brandon Ingram on Darko Rajakovic, Immanuel Quickley, Scottie Barnes, Feb 13, 2025. Source: TSN.

item.title: Jordan Nwora on Immanuel Quickley, Scottie Barnes
item.description:
Nwora said of the trade to Toronto.

“It’s a new situation, new opportunity, and in my head, I’m just going to just make the most of it. Obviously, (in Indiana) things didn’t really work out this year — we were super deep, (I) kinda was the odd man out. Hopefully here, I can take another step and hopefully become a staple, somebody who can be a good supporting cast for guys like Scottie (Barnes), RJ and (Immanuel Quickley).”

Jordan Nwora on Immanuel Quickley, Scottie Barnes, Jan 30, 2024. Source: The Athletic.

item.title: Tom Thibodeau on Immanuel Quickley
item.description:
Fred Katz:Tom Thibodeau on Immanuel Quickley, whose extension deadline is today:

“My hope is we can always find common ground…I'm a big Quickley guy.”

Tom Thibodeau on Immanuel Quickley, Oct 23, 2023. Source: Twitter @FredKatz.

item.title: Terquavion Smith on De'Aaron Fox, Immanuel Quickley, Tyrese Maxey
item.description:
When asked by HoopsHype which players he compares himself with, Terquavion Smith replied,

“I’ve got De’Aaron Fox, Immanuel Quickley, and a little bit of Tyrese Maxey. All of those guys are quick. They shoot the ball well, can create for others, and can play off the ball well.”

Terquavion Smith on De'Aaron Fox, Immanuel Quickley, Tyrese Maxey, May 28, 2023. Source: HoopsHype.

item.title: Tom Thibodeau on Quentin Grimes, Immanuel Quickley
item.description:
“That’s what I like about Quentin. He’s played long minutes, he’s played short minutes. You can start him, you can bring him off the bench and he’s going to be the same every day. We’ve got a bunch of guys — [Immanuel Quickley is] the same way. “I’ve mentioned this before; Even though Quick and Josh, even though they’re not starting, I view them as starters. So those guys will be rotating in and out and I think it keeps them where we can play a high-energy game. I think that’s a plus for us.”

Tom Thibodeau on Quentin Grimes, Immanuel Quickley, Feb 28, 2023. Source: New York Post.

item.title: Tom Thibodeau on Immanuel Quickley
item.description:
Tom Thibodeau on Immanuel Quickley, long-range bomber:

“We have a lot of confidence in his shooting. That's his gift.”

Tom Thibodeau on Immanuel Quickley, May 1, 2021. Source: Twitter @MikeVorkunov.

item.title: Derrick Rose on Immanuel Quickley
item.description:
Ian Begley:Derrick Rose on Immanuel Quickley:

“He's a dog. He's a dog. I can't explain it. You've got to be a player to understand it. We're in a fight, I know he's fighting.”

Derrick Rose on Immanuel Quickley, Feb 10, 2021. Source: Twitter @IanBegley.

item.title: Tom Thibodeau on Immanuel Quickley
item.description:
Knicks coachTom Thibodeau on Immanuel Quickley:

“He’s really talented, he’s smart, and he’s a great worker. I love his attitude. I love his approach. He’s going to be a really good player in this league for a long time.”

Tom Thibodeau on Immanuel Quickley, Jan 3, 2021. Source: Twitter @MikeAScotto.

item.title: Tom Thibodeau on Elfrid Payton, Immanuel Quickley
item.description:
Stefan Bondy:Thibs on picking Payton over Quickley:

“It's a compilation of things. It’s how things have gone in practice, the games, the way the groups play with each other. And starting has never been as important as finishing for me. But we’ll be looking at the different combinations.”

Tom Thibodeau on Elfrid Payton, Immanuel Quickley, Dec 23, 2020. Source: Twitter @SBondyNYDN.
